headline: CNG driver injured in cocktail blast outside July Memorial Museum
summary: A cocktail blast occurred outside the July Memorial Museum, leaving a CNG driver injured.
details: A CNG driver was injured in a cocktail blast that took place outside the July Memorial Museum.
The incident occurred in the vicinity of the museum, causing immediate alarm among bystanders.
Emergency services were alerted to the the blast, and the injured driver was provided with medical assistance.
Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the the blast and the circumstances surrounding the incident.

headline: 8 dead as Tropical Storm Rachel hits Mexico's Pacific coast
summary: Government authorities report a rising death toll as search and rescue operations continue for missing persons.
details: At least eight people have died after Tropical Storm Rachel swept along Mexico's Pacific coast, according to an updated toll from government authorities.
The Mexican army and navy are currently conducting search and rescue operations to locate missing persons.
Two people remain missing as authorities work to manage the aftermath of the storm's impact.
The death toll had previously been reported as four on Monday, doubling in the latest government update.
caption:
8 people dead and 2 still missing after Tropical Storm Rachel hits Mexico's Pacific coast.

At least eight people have died after Tropical Storm Rachel swept along Mexico's Pacific coast, according to an updated toll from government authorities.

The Mexican army and navy are currently conducting search and rescue operations to locate missing persons.

Two people remain missing as authorities work to manage the aftermath of the storm's impact.

The death toll had previously been reported as four on Monday, doubling in the latest government update.
